d:
The Kings defeated the Mavericks, 115-100 tonight in Dallas. Darius Acuff Jr. contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 6 assists 5 rebounds and 2 three pointers, with Malik Monk of the Kings adding an additional 24 points (9-14 FG, 5-8 3P) in the game. Daniel Gafford finished with a team-high 20 points along with 7 rebounds for the Mavericks in the losing effort. The Kings improve their record to 1-6 with the win, while the Mavericks fall to 4-3 for the season.
